summary: Texas Forest Service tower at Beckville, Panola County: 1958 survey description (about 140 ft), 1993 sale notice for dismantling, now listed as gone.

facts.design: Four-legged structure with a grey, glass-enclosed cab
facts.status_note: Listed as gone. A January 1993 Texas Forest Service notice offered the tower for sale, dismantling and removal.

events.note: Coast and Geodetic Survey described the station, with the tower standing over it.
Texas Forest Service notice of sale for dismantling and removal, quoted from the Tyler Morning Telegraph. Removal is not confirmed.

evidence.supports: Survey description of the station made in 1958
evidence.quote: DESCRIBED BY COAST AND GEODETIC SURVEY 1958

evidence.supports: Station about 3.5 miles airline north of Beckville, on a timbered hill, the highest in the vicinity
evidence.quote: THE STATION IS LOCATED ABOUT 3-1/2 MILES, AIRLINE, NORTH OF BECKVILLE ON A PROMINENT TIMBER COVERED HILL THE HIGHEST HILL IN THE VICINITY

evidence.supports: Tower has a grey glass-enclosed cab on a four-legged structure
evidence.quote: THE TOWER HAS A GLASS ENCLOSED CAB GREY IN COLOR AND IS SUPPORTED BY A 4 LEGGED STRUCTURE
THE OVERALL HEIGHT IS APPROXIMATELY 140 FEET.

evidence.supports: January 1993 notice dated January 15, 1993 announcing sale of Texas Forest Service lookout towers
evidence.quote: NOTICE OF SALE OF FIRE LOOKOUT TOWERS

evidence.supports: Sale, dismantling and removal of Texas Forest Service towers, sealed bids
evidence.quote: Sealed bids for the sale, dismantling and removal of fire lookout towers owned by the Texas Forest Service

evidence.supports: The Beckville tower in Panola County was on the sale list
evidence.quote: Fire lookout towers to be sold include: Beckville Fire Lookout Tower, Panola County.

evidence.supports: Association lists Beckville (Loc 2), Panola County, as a tower that is gone
Association has a second Beckville entry, Loc 1

sources.title: Beckville - FOREST LOOKOUTS
sources.publisher: Forest Lookouts (centraluslookouts.weebly.com); quotes a NGS station description and a Tyler Morning Telegraph notice

notes_for_editor: Thin record. Two sources, both secondary: the 1958 NGS station text and the 1993 notice are transcribed on the Forest Lookouts page, and I did not open the NGS datasheet (PID CR1134) or the newspaper itself. The FFLA list has two Beckville entries (Loc 1 at 32.29589, -94.44057; Loc 2 at 32.29934, -94.43776), and nothing read says which one the NGS station or the 1993 tower matches. The Loc 2 record is kept as the target, but that match is unverified. The 140 ft height is an approximate NGS figure. No build date, staffing, access or site-today source was found. Beckville town history pages and the Wikipedia article have no tower information.
